answer_1.quote: At each iteration, new attacking prompts are generated by prompting the adversarial model... we also harvest responsible and highquality answers from the target model for the safety alignment of the target model.
answer_1.outputs: adversarial prompts and safe model responses

answer_2.quote: We use the same safety and helpfulness reward model (RM) for evaluation... For safety, we also consider generation with a safety RM score < 0.5 as unsafe and calculate a violation rate for each dataset.

answer_3.quote: We train a reward model as a proxy for human preference... specifically, we follow Llama 2 and train a helpfulness RM S_h as well as a safety RM S_s separately to provide feedback signals for the target and adversarial models.

answer_4.quote: We follow previous work to use model-based evaluation and validate main results with human evaluation. We ask the same annotators to flag potential harmful and unsafe generation and calculate a violation rate similarly.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to flag potentially harmful or unsafe generations and a violation rate is computed.
